title.narrative: Shah Deniz Stage II Gas Field Expansion Project

description.narrative: The upstream project includes construction of 26 subsea wells, two offshore platforms, gas and condensate subsea pipelines, expansion of the Sangachal terminal, two 900 mmscfd gas compressors, and connection to the South Caucasus Pipeline.
